visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) At night, four people in heavy winter clothing (earmuffs, fur hats, thick coats) stand together in a snowy field. Their mouths are open in a 'wow' expression. The background is dark with faint green glows. (2) The camera cuts to the night sky showing vibrant green and purple aurora borealis swirling above. (3) Daytime at a hot spring. A young man with dark hair is submerged in steaming water, pointing at the camera with a surprised face. He is surrounded by large rocks covered in thick snow. (4) Three young women in colorful swimwear are in the same steaming hot spring, one waves at the camera while the others smile. (5) Various fast-cut shots of people dancing and jumping under the green aurora at night. (6) A text summary graphic appears with the 'SkyHorse' logo, listing travel highlights over a blurred aurora background. (7) A man in a dark jacket loads silver suitcases into the back of a white transit van. (8) View from the front seat of a moving van driving on a wet road lined with frost-covered trees under a dim, overcast sky. (9) A close-up shot of a professional camera screen displays a clear photo of the green aurora over a dark horizon. (10) Social media style photo overlays show individuals posing happily against the aurora. (11) A group selfie shows friends making funny, shocked faces in a snowy environment at night. (12) A Jeep drives through a shallow, slushy river, splashing water towards the camera lens. (13) A lone figure walks across a vast, blueish-white glacier field under a cloudy sky. (14) Inside the Jeep, two women laugh and cheer as the vehicle bounces on rough terrain. (15) Two women in swimwear pose in a steaming hot spring at dusk, with ice-covered trees in the background. (16) Final group shots show the friends hugging and playing in the snow at night under the aurora.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A group of young adults dressed in fashionable winter gear (parkas, earmuffs, beanies) and later in colorful swimwear for the hot spring scenes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features the snowy landscapes of Alaska, featuring the Aurora Borealis in the night sky, frozen glaciers, snow-covered forests, and outdoor thermal hot springs surrounded by ice.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a steady drum beat begin. A female narrator speaks with high energy and an excited tone. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of green text on the screen. (3) Subtle sounds of splashing water are audible beneath the narration as characters interact in the hot spring. (4) Multiple female voices laugh and shout 'Wow!' in the background, creating a high-arousal social atmosphere. (5) Low rumbling of a vehicle engine and tires on a wet road can be heard during the van segments. (6) A sudden splash and rushing water sound occurs as the Jeep crosses a stream. (7) The BGM remains consistent and joyful throughout, maintaining a fast tempo to match the visual montage.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'SkyHorse' travel agency's 7-day tour of Alaska by showcasing spectacular visuals of the aurora borealis, glaciers, and hot springs, emphasizing the emotional joy and professional service of the trip.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of travel agency name 'SkyHorse', detailed itinerary summary, and professional guide services shown.
